scope: New composed source-only regression tests, with controlled transport/submission/reservation adapters and explicitly rewritten synthetic role commitments. No production behavior or live rejection/acceptance/resource claim.

checks.result: Uses actual integrateLocalFinancialCase, runLocalFinancialCase, observeFinalizedStage, installed native codec and createFinancialComparator. Adapters explicitly replace asset loading/preparation, SDK submissions, provider state/counters, transport and state decode; fetch is forbidden. All production modules bound in candidate are unchanged from exact priorReviewedCommit.

Native transactions and financial public state values come from retained loan evidence. Public capability commitments alone are recomputed with two clearly synthetic32-byte secrets to make real comparator binding check possible without reading actual role secrets. The resulting state fixture is source evidence, not a newly decoded live state or original authenticated capability proof.

Submission callbacks merely record stage names and additive synthetic counters; no actual SDK submission or durable reservation provider runs. Controlled observer transport deserializes retained actual native bytes, reconstructs correct Bech32m indexed owners and feeds real observer/finality predicates with inert RPC. This composes actual validations without claiming actual external transport/finality.

Control reaches all four stages through real integration/driver/observer/comparator with financial comparator PASS but outer result SOURCE_TEST_ONLY and financialAcceptance false. Negative cases fail at expected call/observe/compare boundary for wrong payer binding, wrong indexed recipient, missing wire fees, missing observed receipt fees, understated native debit and unauthorized payer in post-observer native projection.

Each negative asserts exact error predicate, allowed submitted/compared prefix, retained IDs, diagnostic phase, additive simulated submission/DUST/gross charges, stopped/cleanup flags and source-only failure result. The final payer mutation occurs after real native signature decoding, so it tests comparator rejection of a corrupted supplied observation; it does not claim a forged signed native transaction was rejected on-chain.

Actual production retainPublicIntegrationResult is called and must reject sourceTestOnly evidence. Separate scratch stage/result writes are explicitly source-test-only and confined to an exclusive temporary directory; cleanup removes it in finally. No production output file or actual allocation is written.

Verified production retention requires sourceTestOnly===false and accepted raw runtime statuses, so the test does not weaken or bypass the existing evidence gate. Scratch storage is separately implemented, not misrepresented as production admission.

Accurately names all seven tests, actual composed validation layers, controlled counters/transport, rewritten capability commitments and source-only retention. Explicitly excludes live Docker rejection/nonmutation, Preview settlement, production changes and resource dispatch.

independentVerification.scope: Offline public artifacts/installed SDK and synthetic temporary files only; no private/service/wallet/network/operational access.

limitations: Counters, SDK submissions, provider execute/stop/cleanup and RPC are controlled fixtures. They establish source stop behavior, not real reservation crash consistency, actual wallet cleanup or live ledger nonmutation.
Post-observer mutations deliberately alter a trusted-interface projection; they do not demonstrate native proof/signature forgery or malformed transaction rejection by the actual network.
Synthetic capability commitments mean comparator success is scoped to the constructed state fixture. No actual private secret or authenticated private store was accessed.
Source-only scratch files are not production-retained acceptance evidence; production retention rejects them. These tests neither approve nor interfere with the separately admitted live swap run.
